data.title: 尤贝尔 · 黑暗料理的现场
data.description: 借住处的厨房，她哼着歌往锅里投入颜色可疑的食材，锅里冒出不该出现的颜色的蒸汽；端上桌时一脸期待地盯着试吃者，黑暗料理名不虚传。
data.action: 借住处的厨房，她哼着歌往锅里投入颜色可疑的食材，锅里冒出不该出现的颜色的蒸汽
data.promptProse: Standing beside the rustic stove of a borrowed kitchen in her forest-green shirt and plain linen apron, Ubel leans cheerfully over a simmering iron pot of dubious stew. She drops a suspiciously colored vegetable into the broth with casual amusement as thick, eerie green steam curls upward, shooting the viewer a sly, expectant grin. Warm overhead kitchen light fills the wooden counter, spice jars, and the rising green vapor around her hand.
data.animaCaption: Standing at the kitchen stove in her linen apron, Ubel drops a strange vegetable into the simmering pot as eerie green steam curls upward and gives the viewer an expectant grin. Warm kitchen lighting highlights the counter and rising vapor.
